title: Human Approval Challenge
description: Fail-closed cycle-free approval challenge. Preallocate id, build a human_approval_presentation containing full typed target/scope, hash its canonical UTF-8 bytes, then create this record with presentationArtifact. targetScopeSha256 is always the canonical SHA-256 of exactly {gateType,target,scope}; for w0-run-authorization it is distinct from the scope-only scopeCoreSha256 and both are rederived. canonicalResponse is 'APPROVE ' + id + ' ' + targetScopeSha256. The exact presentation—not a bare digest—must be sent before the human response. Chronology is issuedAt <= selected presentation time < selected human response time <= capture.occurredAt <= provenance verifiedAt; run authorization additionally requires externally proven one-time nonce consumption.

presentationArtifact.description: Schema-valid human_approval_presentation canonical bytes. challengeId/gateType/issuedAt/digest/canonicalResponse must equal this challenge.

operatorExternalAbsolutePath.description: Resolved absolute operator-external path outside the locked project/package/baseline/installed-Skill trees.
